prompts.portrait: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE production-ready game PNG asset based on the supplied approved warrior concept board (reference image, not a layout to copy). Match exactly its adult human warrior identity, tousled short dark brown hair, cool blue-gray steel with realistic wear, muted bronze diamond emblems/trim, brown leather and dark burgundy cloth. Polished semi-realistic painted fantasy game illustration, clean silhouette, soft material highlights. No text, labels, border, watermark, environment or decorative background. A truly TRANSPARENT alpha background, no white canvas, no checkerboard baked into image, no glow or ground shadow. Asset: a single full-body standing warrior, same man as the board's left panel, head through boots fully visible with generous 4% transparent margins. Portrait 2:3 composition, standing upright front three-quarter view, calm stern human face looking slightly toward viewer's right, empty relaxed hands. Reproduce the layered steel plate armor, bronze diamond crest and trims, dark burgundy shoulder cloak/tabard, leather straps, boots, and rugged realistic materials of the approved design. Keep cape behind body and contained within frame. Long elegant adult proportions; no sword, no second person, no avatar or ball. This image will be enlarged on the left of a selection page with its lower body behind a UI panel; keep head and torso highly readable.
